slides.texte_overlay:
Low-key details that make you
more attractive than you think
A warm, slow voice. Speaking a little slower and lower than usual sounds calm and confident, and people find a relaxed voice instantly more attractive.
Knowing how to cook one dish really well. Not ten, just one you can make perfectly for someone. It's caring, practical and quietly impressive every time.
Good manners with older people. Helping your neighbour with shopping, chatting kindly with someone's grandmother. Kindness across generations always shows.
A tidy, simple style. Clothes that fit, colours that match, clean shoes. You don't need fashion, you just need to look like you take care of yourself.
Curiosity about the world. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and having interesting things to share makes every date and dinner better.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Interesting things to share make every date and dinner better.

slides.texte_overlay: Being on time. Arriving when you said you would shows respect, and respect is one of the most underrated attractive qualities a man can have. Late every time says the opposite.
Laughing at yourself. A man who can laugh at his own small mistakes is relaxed and secure, and that ease draws people in. Nobody wants to be around someone who takes himself too seriously.
